capabilities: Publish the vault to the Markdown Vault service
Share published content through a sharing link
Configure publishing with a vault UUID and API key
Protect published content with a password (paid)
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Freemium: password protection requires a paid subscription. Additional documentation is on the plugin's website, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish a vault so readers can download and view it in a dedicated iPhone app.

requires.name: Markdown Vault paid subscription for password protection

summary: Publishing plugin that sends an Obsidian vault to the Markdown Vault service for viewing in a dedicated iOS app via a sharing link.
